verses.1: And it was after twelve years, in two dozen months each month. It was during one of those months that the LORD said to me:
verses.2: The son of man laid a curse upon Pharaoh, the king of Egypt. He said to him, “You are like a wicked nation. You have lived in your rivers and lakes, and you have swum in your waters. But now, you will be destroyed.”
verses.3: Thus said Adonai YHWH: “I have spread out My kingdom before you among many nations. You will be exalted in their midst.”
verses.4: And I will lay you down on the ground, in the midst of the field. I will cover you with all the stars of heaven, and I will bless you so that your life will be like that of all the other creatures on earth.
verses.5: And I will set your words upon the mountains. I will fill your heights with valleys.
verses.6: And I will fill your land with tears, from your mountains. Rivers will overflow from it.
verses.7: And I will cover the heavens with your darkness. I will make their lights shine in the clouds. There, they will fly around, but their light will not shine at all.
verses.8: All the lights in the heavens will shine upon you. But I will bring darkness over your land, says the Lord God.
verses.9: And I became angry with many nations when I brought your curse upon their lands, on those lands that you did not know.
verses.10: And I will fill you with many nations, and their kings will tremble before you. They will be terrified on that day. Every person will be in fear for his life on that day of your destruction.
verses.11: For thus said Adonai YHWH: “Babylon will be destroyed, and you will be taken captive.”
verses.12: In the days of those powerful rulers, all the oppressors of other nations were destroyed. They plundered the treasures of Egypt, and all those who were cruel were defeated.
verses.13: And I have destroyed all their livestock in the midst of many waters. No human being will ever be able to survive again, and no animals will be able to survive either.
verses.14: Then I will extinguish their light, and they will be destroyed like smoke. May the name of the LORD be praised!
verses.15: I have made the land of Egypt desolate and empty. The land is now full of ruins. All its inhabitants will know that I, Jehovah, am their God.
verses.16: Kina is a name given to the daughters of the nations. They are called “Kina” because they are associated with Egypt and all its people. May Jehovah bless them, we pray.
verses.17: And in the twenty-two years, on the fifteenth day of the twelfth month, God spoke to me with these words:
verses.18: Man lay down on the ground in Egypt, and they brought him up from there. Then they took his children from the land of Egypt and led them to a land where they could live.
verses.19: From whom did you receive the gift of sleep and rest?
verses.20: In the depths of chaos, destruction will fall. A punishment will be imposed upon them, along with all those who are involved in it.
verses.21: They spoke to him, the rulers of Sheol. His rescuers came down; they lay down in the depths of destruction.
verses.22: There, Ashur and all his people’s graves are destroyed. They all perish in destruction.
verses.23: Their bodies were laid in the graves. Around their graves, there were many people who were also buried there. They all died in that destruction. Their bodies were laid in the land of the living.
verses.24: There, Eilam and all those around him were destroyed. They were all destroyed in the destruction that came upon them. They were sent down to a land of desolation, where they were given no chance to live. They lost their lives completely.
verses.25: In the midst of tombs, they were laid down in all directions. All their surroundings were filled with corpses. They were buried in the land of the living. They carried their remains along with them. In the midst of tombs, they were laid down.
verses.26: There, in that place, there are tombs and all kinds of people who were buried there. They are all covered with filth and dirt. Their bodies were placed in the land of the living.
verses.27: And let them not lay the slain nobles upon their bodies. For those nobles who fell in all their battles, Shaul brought their corpses down from their positions. Their bodies were left lying there, as if they had been buried alive in the land of the living.
verses.28: And you, who are among the enemies, will be destroyed and your abode will be lost.
verses.29: Adam became their king, and all their rulers who were given authority over them. They destroyed the cities of Harim; their towers were destroyed, and their rulers also perished.
verses.30: All the princes of Sion were gathered together, along with all those who descended from heaven in their chariots. They covered the ruins of Jerusalem with their bodies. They also carried away all the treasures of Boor.
verses.31: May the Pharaoh see them and be merciful to all those who are in the ruins of Pharaoh’s destruction. May all his soldiers be saved, O Adonai of Jehovah.
verses.32: For I have placed my throne in the land of life; it lies within the midst of mountains. The ruins of Pharaoh’s palace and all its inhabitants are now buried there. May the Lord God bless me!
